scope: Targeted primary-source supplement, not exhaustive global bibliometrics. External papers are not added to the original paper database or mixed into local counts.

sources.title: PenGym: Pentesting Training Framework for Reinforcement Learning Agents
sources.supports: Uses emulated network actions as an RL training environment; a concrete predecessor for RL × pentesting × ranges.

sources.title: PenGym: Realistic training environment for reinforcement learning pentesting agents
sources.status: journal paper, Computers & Security 148, 104140; DOI contains 2024
sources.supports: Automates cyber range creation, extends actions and compares emulation with revised NASim simulation. Realism is an existing research question, not a new 2026 invention.

sources.title: CAGE challenge 4: A scalable multi-agent reinforcement learning gym for autonomous cyber defence
sources.supports: A concrete benchmark for multi-agent cyber defense and generalization; benchmark success does not imply production deployment.

sources.title: Towards a Generalisable Cyber Defence Agent for Real-World Computer Networks
sources.supports: Heterogeneous graph state representation plus fixed semantic action space for differing network topology and size in CAGE-4.

sources.title: HoneyGPT: Breaking the Trilemma in Terminal Honeypots with Large Language Model
sources.status: arXiv first submission 2024-06-04; page version revised 2025-02-15; no venue inferred
sources.supports: Shell emulation using an LLM, longer interaction and memory consistency; distinguishes a model used as a honeypot from an attacking LLM agent.

sources.title: Cyber-Physical Deception Through Coordinated IoT Honeypots
sources.status: USENIX Security paper; also present locally
sources.supports: Prolog dependencies and SDN coordination maintain cyber/physical state consistency across multiple IoT decoys.

sources.title: Cloak, Honey, Trap: Proactive Defenses Against LLM Agents
sources.status: USENIX Security paper; also present locally
sources.supports: LLM-specific tokens, asset cloaking and traps against autonomous attackers, evaluated on CTF hosts; not a general production success rate.

sources.title: PentestGPT: Evaluating and Harnessing Large Language Models for Automated Penetration Testing
sources.status: USENIX Security paper; also present locally
sources.supports: Task context and module coordination; original evaluation includes human execution/feedback, unlike a fully autonomous multi-host benchmark.

sources.title: Incalmo: An Autonomous LLM-assisted System for Red Teaming Multi-Host Networks
sources.status: IEEE S&P; author publication page; also present locally
sources.supports: High-level declarative planning, task agents, state/asset services, MHBench with 22-50 hosts; author page path date is not the venue year.

sources.title: IntelliTopo: An IaC Generation Service for Industrial Network Topology Construction
sources.status: ASE Industry Showcase; also present locally
sources.supports: Natural-language requirements to whole topology using semantic parsing and domain-aware image retrieval; functional topology does not itself establish exploitability.

sources.title: AutoLabel: Automated Fine-Grained Log Labeling for Cyber Attack Dataset Generation
sources.status: USENIX Security paper; also present locally
sources.supports: Attack execution and fine-grained labeled logs; distinct from arbitrary topology generation.

sources.title: RangeFactory: Scalable Construction of Multi-Hop Cyber Ranges
sources.status: arXiv preprint submitted 2026-08-10; no peer-reviewed venue verified
sources.supports: Combines isolated vulnerable environments via dependency resolution and end-to-end attack validation; a direct recent precedent for multi-hop range generation.

sources.title: CyberWorld: World Models for Sample-Efficient Autonomous Cyber Defense
sources.status: arXiv preprint submitted 2026-09-25; no peer-reviewed venue verified
sources.supports: Dreamer-style latent cyber dynamics and policy optimization in imagined trajectories; early model-based defense evidence, not established sim-to-real success.
